Name: Customize Clothing Gender
Author: bubbleopaque
Description:
This mod allows you to customize the "gender" of clothing you receive from tailoring and the Desert Festival makeover stall. In the vanilla game, some tailoring recipes will give you either a male or female version of the clothing item based on your farmer's gender/body type. And during the Desert Festival makeover, some outfits are only obtainable to female farmers, and some only to male farmers. This mod seeks to make Stardew Valley more friendly to trans and gender non-conforming players (as well as anyone else who would benefit) by providing more control over the clothing that players receive in-game.

[b][size=5]Install[/size][/b]
[list=1]
[*]Install the latest version of [url=https://smapi.io]SMAPI[/url]
[*]Install the latest version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]
[*]Install the latest version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] (recommended)
[*]Download this mod and unzip it into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font]
[*]Run the game using SMAPI
[/list][b][size=5]How to use[/size][/b]
To change your clothing preferences, you can either use the in-game menu provided by Generic Mod Config Menu (recommended), or you can manually edit the [font=Courier New]config.json[/font] file that will appear in this mod's folder after the game has been launched (note: if you choose to edit the config menu, the game will have to be reopened for the changes to take effect). The mod has two config settings: Clothing Style and Makeover Outfit Style.

[b][size=4]Clothing Style[/size][/b]
This refers to the "gender" or style of clothing you get from certain tailoring recipes. A few recipes have both masculine and feminine versions, so this setting allows you to choose which version you'll get, regardless of your farmer's gender/body type. There are 4 options for this setting: Default, Masculine, Feminine, and Random.
[list]
[*][b]Default:[/b] This works the same as the vanilla game, using your farmer's gender to determine which clothing version you get. If your farmer is male (or body type 1, if using the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/722]Gender Neutrality Mod[/url]﻿), you will receive the masculine versions, and if your farmer is female (body type 2), you will receive the feminine versions.
[*][b]Masculine:[/b] If this option is selected, you will receive the masculine version of tailoring recipes, regardless of your gender/body type.
[*][b]Feminine:[/b] If this option is selected, you will receive the feminine version of tailoring recipes, regardless of your gender/body type.
[*][b]Random:[/b] When tailoring, you could receive either the feminine or masculine version of the item, randomly selected each time you craft it.
[/list]
[size=4][b]Makeover Outfit Style[/b][/size][u]
[/u]Outfits that you can receive from Emily's makeover stand at the Desert Festival are classed in-game as male, female, or neutral (with the majority being neutral). In the vanilla game, if your farmer is male, you can only receive male or neutral outfits, and vice versa. This setting lets you change that with 5 options: Default, Masculine, Feminine, Any, and Neutral Only.[b]
[/b][list]
[*][b]Default:[/b] Similar to the Clothing Style option, this makes no changes to how the makeover outfits work.
[*][b]Masculine:[/b] You will only get outfits typically available to a male farmer, i.e., outfits that are either masculine or neutral.
[*][b]Feminine:[/b] You will only get outfits typically available to a female farmer, i.e., outfits that are either feminine or neutral.
[*][b]Any:[/b] You could get any of the makeover outfits: masculine, feminine, or neutral.
[*][b]Neutral Only:[/b] You will only get outfits classed as neutral.
[/list][b][size=5]Compatibility[/size][/b]
[list]
[*]Works with Stardew Valley 1.6 on Linux/macOS/Windows
[*]Works in single player and multiplayer
